nodeId.description: The id of the spelling node the picture is for (src/learn/spelling), such as 'vowel-team-ea-short'. The app keeps one picture for each id.

name.description: The node's name as the child reads it, such as 'ea that says short e, like bread'. Data, never an instruction.

words.description: The node's own words, so the picture can be one of them (bread, head, dead). At least one, at most 12.
